summary: postinstall beacons host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: On npm install, the package's postinstall hook executes index.cjs, which collects host reconnaissance data (os.hostname(), os.homedir(), process.platform) and CI-provider fingerprints derived from well-known CI environment variables, then POSTs them as JSON to a hardcoded bare-IP HTTPS endpoint at https://130.162.231.177:8443/. The destination is not a package publisher domain, is not caller-configurable, and the behavior fires automatically on default install with no documentation or opt-out. The package's self-description as a mock/test server does not match this install-time outbound beacon behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
